items.name: Readability
items.evidence: Two-line change with a clear comment, '# Ensure base table is in aliases.', and it calls the existing, well-named helper get_initial_alias(). It matches the reference exactly.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the existing query.get_initial_alias() helper and leaves Collector and QuerySet.delete untouched. No duplicated or dead code, and no debug leftovers in the diff.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Minimal change with no new error-handling surface. get_initial_alias() is idempotent, joined queries still count more than one alias, and there are no magic constants or swallowed exceptions.

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: The root cause is fixed inside single_alias, so the MySQL compiler that also uses single_alias benefits too. Joined deletes keep the subquery. The agent verified 'DELETE FROM "auth_permission"', and hidden tests passed F2P 1/1 and P2P 52/52.
